correctness.rationale: Any admissible C_n word has at least one label2. Successive 2-labels in cyclic order must be separated by distances 2,3,4, with unique forced interiors 0, 00, or 010; d≥5 forces adjacent positive non-2 internals and fails independence. Conversely every cyclic concatenation is admissible. Distinguishing a 2 and dividing by the number k of 2-labels proves n(k−1)!/(a!b!c!) and weight 2a+2b+3c. Since 3w−2n=2a+c, residue-class analysis gives known minimum ceil(2n/3) and optimizer count 3/n/n(n+1)/6. Exhaustively enumerated labelings n=5..11 independently, reproducing full coefficient arrays and minima. This is an all-orders combinatorial proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The scalar minimum independent Roman number on cycles is known, leaving its full admissible-function distribution a natural graph-enumeration question. A complete all-weight generating polynomial, gap structure, and mod-three exact optimum multiplicities provide precise reusable information for cycles of all sizes. An exact enumerator is a meaningful invariant, not simply recomputation of the minimum.

final_claim: For cycles C_n, n≥5, all independent Roman functions are exactly cyclic concatenations of forced 2,3,4-distance 2-label gaps; their full weight polynomial is the stated multinomial composition sum and minimum-function counts are 3, n, or n(n+1)/6 by n mod 3.
limitations: Cycle result is n≥5, labeled rather than dihedral-orbit counts; 2012 scalar minimum is prior.
Resultary nearest all-function theorem covers only C3/C4 via complete multipartite graphs.
